title: The Beggar in the Hall
blurb: The suitors have all failed Penelope's trial of the bow. Then a ragged beggar speaks up, and Antinous isn't laughing for long.

characters.name: Antinous
characters.description: Arrogant leader of the suitors. Mocking, then furious.

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: The queen. Composed, cold, in total command.

characters.name: The Beggar
characters.description: Odysseus in disguise. Says little. Means everything.

lines.text: All of us who failed your test.
lines.direction: Sneer at the queen. Sweep a hand across the crowd of suitors.
Quiet and steady. The whole hall turns to look at you.

lines.text: Can somebody get these beggars out of here?
lines.direction: Turn to the crowd, laughing. Wave the beggar off.

lines.text: The doors are locked until the trial's over.
lines.direction: Cold authority. Never raise your voice.
Snap back. The smile is gone.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film) clip; transcribed with Whisper, speakers assigned by shot
